subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal `requireMention` behavior for groups that already configure a bot account identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and well-proven, but merging it intentionally changes upgrade behavior by quieting previously delivered Signal group chatter that does not natively mention the bot.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge this fix after normal maintainer review, accepting that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups become quieter and match the documented mention contract.

options.title: Require a compatibility guard
options.body: Ask for an opt-in, migration note, or default-preserving compatibility path before changing existing Signal group delivery behavior.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Leave Signal native mentions dependent on text fallback patterns for now and keep the native-only mention gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge this fix after normal maintainer review, accepting that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups become quieter and match the documented mention contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent central mention-policy and Signal group-gating commits make this the strongest history-backed owner for the compatibility decision.
